name: uri-permit-no-uri-san-in-leaf-valid
description: Intermediate CA carries permittedSubtrees uniformResourceIdentifier=.example.com but the leaf has no URI SAN — only a DNS SAN. Per RFC 5280 4.2.1.10, name constraints apply only to names of the constrained type that are present in the leaf; a certificate that contains no URI name is acceptable under any URI constraint. GnuTLS <3.4.3 rejected such chains because unsupported URI/IP permitted constraints triggered blanket rejection even when no name of that form was present.
references: GnuTLS NEWS 3.4.3 — URI/IP constraints rejected certificates that had no URI/IP SAN
